name: In'yoku 2
source:
Main character is a salary-man in a food company. He has to work overtime and on holidays because of an incompetent director. He knows his director is a regular at a SM club. Protagonists joins this club to have his revenge on the director and get new acquaintances.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-november-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是一家食品公司的上班族。由于主管不称职，他不得不加班加点、节假日加班。他知道他的导演是SM俱乐部的常客。主角们加入这个俱乐部是为了向导演复仇并结识新朋友。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-november-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
